causes.text: Nvidia issued a strong revenue forecast tied to surging demand for its AI processors. The guidance reinforced expectations for sustained high-volume orders to advanced-node foundry partners.

source_info.title: Nvidia's shares soar after blowout earnings as booming AI demand fuels chip sector rally

effects.text: TSMC ADR rose as investors extrapolated stronger wafer demand from Nvidia into TSMC's advanced node utilization. The move reflected expectations of sustained AI-driven orders.

source_info.title: Nvidia adds over $200 billion in market value in post-earnings rally; TSMC ADR ends up 0.6%

causal_reasoning_chain.description: Nvidia guided to stronger-than-expected demand for AI accelerators, implying continued large orders to upstream foundry partners for advanced nodes.
Investors mapped Nvidia's order trajectory to TSMC's capacity utilization and mix, improving expected revenue visibility and margins for leading nodes.
On 2024-05-23, TSMC ADR ended up 0.6% (up), consistent with demand-driven optimism tied to Nvidia's forecast.

rationale: The Nvidia forecast increases demand-side pull for TSMC's advanced processes, tightening capacity and supporting pricing.
counterfactual_analysis: Had Nvidia signaled weaker AI demand, investors would likely have reduced expectations for TSMC's utilization and mix, limiting the same-day rise.

adversarial_confounders.text: A broad tech rally unrelated to Nvidia's guidance could lift most semiconductor stocks.
adversarial_confounders.impact: This would weaken attribution, but the reaction concentrated in AI supply chain names supports the causal reading.

adversarial_confounders.text: Currency moves in USD/TWD or macro prints could nudge ADRs.
adversarial_confounders.impact: FX noise is typically smaller than event-driven sector moves and unlikely to explain timing.

details.commentary: Stronger AI chip demand at Nvidia feeds directly into higher wafer orders at advanced node partners like TSMC, lifting capacity utilization and supporting future pricing. As investors anticipate that recurring AI workloads will justify continued capital spending and volume growth, positive expectations about that feedback loop help drive the ADR higher.
